Open the complete GyaniSays website

This is a React source entry. The form, admin login and database need the Node server.

Go back to the project folder and double-click START-WEBSITE.cmd. It starts the local server and opens the website. Install Node.js 24+ first. Internet is needed for the first dependency installation.

If the server is already running: Open complete website →

Keep the server window open. See SETUP_STEPS.md for deployment and production settings.
